tools.name: recommend_models
tools.description: Rank Hello, AI's tracked frontier models for a task. Same scoring as GET /api/recommend: task match 40%, Elo 35%, input cost 15%, context 10% (Elo 55%, cost 25%, context 20% when no task matches). Only rated models rank; unrated ones are listed separately. score is an ordering aid, not a quality mea

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: All tracked models with full records: Elo and its provenance (elo_source), prices per million tokens, context window, strengths, description. rated is false when the stored Elo is a predecessor's, missing or stale.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One tracked model's full record by id (claude, fable, muse, gemini, qwen, grok) or exact name.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The curated use-case categories with their curator-chosen leader and a one-paragraph insight. The leader is a hand-set label, not derived from Elo.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Recent Hello, AI articles, newest first: title, date, category, excerpt and URL.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Data freshness, app version, model and article counts, the scoring version and snapshot fingerprint, and the rate limit.
